methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Iterates over all dictionary entries. When working with [unvalidated] input, consider [`Self::iter_try`] to avoid panics due to invalid data.

methods.summary: Returns an iterator that attempts to visit all dictionary entries, producing `Err` if the iterator encounters [invalid] data.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: The number of metadata dictionary entries
